description: This file defines the InputValidationMiddleware class within the AWS SDK for PHP. The class provides input parameter validation middleware for AWS commands, ensuring required parameters are non-empty.

classes.name: InputValidationMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for validating required input parameters in AWS SDK commands. It ensures that specific parameters are non-empty before processing the command.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Static method to create a middleware wrapper that enforces validation based on the provided service and mandatory attributes list.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the middleware with the next handler, service, and list of mandatory attributes.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Allows the class instance to be invoked as a function, performing validation on the command parameters before passing control to the next handler.
